olivia_support: FYI escalated: ACME (acct acme-prod) reports a model output regression after last rollout — outputs are returning an old email header template that contains deprecated/internal copy. Customer pasted examples and is worried about data leakage.
chris_sre: any deploy id / rollout timestamp? did we flip any caching flags? :thinking: 
olivia_support: Rollout id r-20240721-3 per deploy-bot. Customer first saw it ~2024-07-21T22:30Z. Example from them: 
olivia_support: Prompt: "Generate welcome email for user X"
olivia_support: Output (unexpected): "Dear Jane,
[OLD INTERNAL HEADER - DO NOT SHARE]
Welcome to our old onboarding flow..." — header text references a retired template.
maria_ml: This smells like KV/prefix cache returning stale prefix entries from a previous model variant. Could be a keying mismatch during the variant swap.
alex_support: Can we get a minimal repro to confirm? ask the customer for a curl example and model param.
alex_support: Example repro we can run internally:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood-13b-q5","prompt":"Generate welcome email for user X","user_id":"test-user","prefix_version":"v2"}'
```
chris_sre: I'll check kv-store and cache logs for prefix keys and any write/read mismatches. @deploy-bot can you show rollout metadata and which hosts were affected?
deploy-bot: Deploy r-20240721-3 -> canary prod-us-west-2 @2024-07-21T22:12Z -> promoted full @2024-07-21T22:25Z. Config change: prefix_hashing=true, prefix_versioning=opt-in.
chris_sre: I'm seeing high prefix cache hit rates but also mismatched key namespaces on hosts i-0a1b2c3d,i-0b2c3d4e. Looks like writes included model-variant tag in the key while some reads still used the base model id.
maria_ml: Likely root cause: we introduced variant-tag in key derivation in PR #4567; the rollout created a window where some instances wrote keys with variant tag and others read/wrote with the old base key. Result: stale entries for certain routes returning previous template. Fixes: (A) always include variant in key atomically, (B) run scoped invalidation during rollout.
june_csm: Customer on paid SLA; they want ETA and mitigation now. :exclamation:
alex_support: Mitigation options: 1) scoped prefix cache purge for the customer's account 2) revert prefix_hashing toggle 3) pin routing for ACME to previous model variant. Recommend scoped purge + pin to be minimally disruptive.
chris_sre: I'll perform a scoped purge and set a model pin for the account. Running: 
```bash
rbctl cache purge --scope account:acme-prod --pattern "prefix:*:acme-prod" --confirm
rbctl routing pin --account acme-prod --model gpt-redwood-13b-q4 --reason "hotfix for stale-prefix-entries"
```
chris_sre: Purge done at 2024-07-21T23:05Z, model pin applied. Beginning traffic checks and tracing for acme-prod.
olivia_support: Customer ran quick verification and reports the header no longer appears in their test requests. :relieved: They want a post-mortem and assurance this won't recur.
maria_ml: I'll lead the fix: update key-derivation to include immutable model-version tag, add unit/integration tests to simulate mixed-version writes/reads, and add a pre-rollout hook to invalidate prefix caches scoped by model family. I'll open PR and link.
chris_sre: I'll add a rollout hook to invalidate affected prefix keys when we change the model variant in a deployment. Also adding an alert for sudden spike in template mismatches.
sentry-bot: Observability: no new errors post-purge; request traces for acme-prod show expected responses. :white_check_mark:
june_csm: Customer asked for audit logs for the purge command. chris_sre can you share the log?
chris_sre: Uploaded audit log and command output to internal storage: https://internal.redwood/audits/1719001234-kv-purge-acme (accessible to CSM and infra).
olivia_support: Closing escalation for now; keeping thread open for post-mortem and PR links. Thanks team. :memo:
